**Ruling record · 2026-11-24T08:1xZ** (maintainer, bug-discussion thread of project objectstack #3)

The maintainer shaped a new Studio (epic #36890): no top pillar nav at all; a collapsible left menu grouped by type → list → item opened full-screen in the right content area. On the decision card 「9 个待定决定和现有卡调整，按建议办吗？」 (06:36Z) they chose 「全部按建议」, which covers this card:

- **Section 二 (top navigation) is superseded** by #36890 and will not be done here. The left menu is #36899; the placement of 「变更」「发布」 (AI drafts only) after the nav goes is answered there.
- **Section 一 (tab order) stands** as written: 记录、字段布局（或表单）、验证、操作、设置、钩子、API; narrow widths fold 钩子 and API first. It touches `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:7343-7353`, the same block as #36904 (object designer full-screen). If this card is not taken before #36904 is dispatched, #36904 delivers it (its body says so); the seat decides, so the block is touched once.
- 「不删、不隐藏任何页签和页头图标」: the five header icons (`StudioItemTools`) become tabs through the shared tab component of #36901, wired in by #36903 / #36904 / #36905; this card does not move them.

Part of epic #36890 (listed there as related; the card keeps its own parent #36510).
